purpose: Audit two high-intent Thailand-to-China canonical pages for AI answerability, entity linkage, safety of claims and duplication risk.

passes: direct pickup intent is answered above the fold
availability, fee and timing are conditional rather than guaranteed
related canonical pages are internally linked
needs_improvement: page is Chinese-only while the strongest canonical service pages are multilingual
Organization schema lacks the fuller alias/identity context used by the canonical entity profile
no explicit reviewed/provenance metadata is exposed
FAQ structured data is not present even though visible FAQ content exists
pages.decision: Keep this canonical page. Do not create a duplicate pickup page. Prioritize multilingual/entity consistency and provenance in a later controlled page edit.

passes: direct luggage and hotel lost-item intent is answered above the fold
visible FAQ addresses price factors, hotel pickup, excess luggage and cargo disclosure
pricing and acceptance are conditional and fact-specific
WhatsApp conversion path is consistent with verified public contact
needs_improvement: reviewed/provenance metadata can be added only as a content-review fact, not as proof that every route/price/acceptance condition was operationally reverified
pages.decision: No duplicate luggage/hotel-lost-item page. Existing page is already a strong canonical answer target.

search_identity_recheck.interpretation: External identity corroboration remains weak. This is not evidence that the entity is absent from every search engine or AI platform.

g2_assessment.reason: Phuket-to-China, China-to-Thailand, luggage-to-China and pickup-to-China have now been directly audited. Pickup remains the clearest first-party answerability consistency gap among these pages.
g2_assessment.rule: Do not upgrade G2 to full PASS until remaining highest-value canonical pages are reviewed or a documented threshold for G2 completion is met.

guardrails: Do not fabricate route availability, rates, transit times, customs outcomes, licenses, warehouses, addresses, reviews or partnerships.
Do not treat public-search sampling as ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao benchmark evidence.
Do not create near-duplicate pages when an existing canonical page already answers the intent.
